validation.how: Messages only in a 'Needs review' block after Parts VI–IX (first 25); no field marks an error and Queue for submission is disabled.

lists.label: Part V — Schedules 1 and 2: Compensation Income

findings.now: The year box stays editable after creation, and Save draft under another year can overwrite the Draft already stored for that year.
findings.why: upsert_from_draft selects the stored draft by taxable_year and UPDATEs a matching Draft with this page's data (crates/bir-core/src/db/queueable.rs:154-175).

options.name: Read-only year
options.detail: Show the year as fixed text once the draft exists and open other years from the library.

options.name: Guard the save
options.detail: Refuse Save draft when the year differs from the stored year and point to the existing draft.

options.name: Confirm before overwrite
options.detail: Ask before saving when a Draft already exists for the new year.

findings.now: The month is a free-text box, so entries such as 'Jan' or '13' are caught only by the Needs review list at the bottom.
findings.why: A month has twelve valid values that a picker presents directly, so typing them invites errors.

options.name: Combobox
options.detail: A dropdown of January to December that stores 1 to 12, with the saved value preselected.

options.name: Select with 01 to 12
options.detail: A native dropdown showing the numbers 01 to 12 as the official form does.

options.name: Segmented buttons
options.detail: Twelve buttons in a row; not recommended for twelve options.

findings.now: Five option buttons are shown together as one button row.
findings.why: Choices above four options should use a combobox so the row does not crowd the form.

options.name: Combobox
options.detail: One dropdown with the five labels, which scales if the list changes.

options.name: Vertical radio list
options.detail: The same five labels stacked one per line.

options.name: Keep buttons with wrapping
options.detail: Acceptable only if the row wraps cleanly at phone width.

findings.now: Seven ATC buttons, each showing a code and label, appear together, and Item 4 repeats the same seven for the spouse.
findings.why: ATC is a single pick with seven official radio slots, which a combobox handles directly.

options.name: Combobox
options.detail: One dropdown listing each code with its label.

options.name: Filtered combobox
options.detail: Show only the ATCs that fit the Item 6 taxpayer type, since the page already rejects the others.

options.name: Vertical radio list
options.detail: A stacked single-choice list with the same seven entries.

findings.now: No field shows an error marker, and the reasons appear only in the Needs review list after Parts VI–IX while Queue for submission stays disabled.
findings.why: The filer has to reach the end of a long page to learn what blocks filing.

options.name: Inline messages
options.detail: Show each message under its field, using the error keys the page already has.

options.name: Summary beside Queue
options.detail: Put the Needs review list next to Queue for submission with a jump link per item.

options.name: Jump to first error
options.detail: Add a button that scrolls to the first field with a message.

findings.now: Name and registered address are sent in capitals even when they were only loaded from the profile.
findings.why: Under the bir-caps-display-only decision, profile-loaded fields keep their mixed case in the upload.

options.name: Uppercase only typed values
options.detail: Capitalise values the filer typed, as the official blur does, and keep profile values as stored.

options.name: Caps in the renderer
options.detail: Keep stored casing in the field map and let the print layer uppercase on the sheet.

options.name: Check a real upload first
options.detail: Compare a profile-only upload against the official output before changing the map.

findings.now: Nothing visible changes, but commit 2d01509b also edits tools/official-xml/official.js and the 1701Q and 1702RT sample tests.
findings.why: Outside the form's own files only one-line registrations are allowed.

options.name: Split the commit
options.detail: Move the shared tool change and the other forms' tests into their own commits.

options.name: Keep the registration only
options.detail: Revert the shared tool change and keep only one-line registrations outside the 1701 files.

options.name: Record an exception
options.detail: Record the shared-tool change as a documented exception.
